audience: help desk and product teams that answer tickets in UseResponse

useCases.title: Review open tickets and their comments
useCases.text: List the help desk tickets, filtered by status or responsible agent. Then read the comments on one ticket.

useCases.title: Trace the history of a ticket
useCases.text: Read one ticket or topic, then its change history, to see what changed and when.

useCases.title: Find a customer and their tickets
useCases.text: Search customers and staff by name, email or team. Then list the tickets and topics that one user created.

useCases.title: Read a saved report
useCases.text: List the saved reports of the account, then read the rows of one report with its sorting and grouping.

useCases.title: Open a ticket or add a comment
useCases.text: Open a new ticket or topic, or add a comment to one. Customers see a new ticket at once, and see a comment unless it is a private staff note.
